sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mahesh Chandra Tripathi,J.
Hon'ble Prashant Kumar,J.
1. Heard Ms. Sofia Khan, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Aga for State respondents.

2. The petitioner has approached this Court for following relief:-
"(a) Issue a writ order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding the
respondent no.2 and 3 to execute/ enforce orders of Nbw and process of section 82
of CrPC in view of order dated 18.04.2024 and Notice/ order dated 24.02.2025
Smt Sadhana vs State Of Uttar Pradesh 3 Others on 9 April, 2025

Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/57248931/
1 passed by learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Mahoba against the accused/
respondent no.4 in Complaint Case No.2459 of 2023 under Sections 376 IPC relating to Police Station Charkhari Distt. Mahoba."

3. On the matter being taken up today, learned counsel for the petitioner, on the instructions, states that cause for filing the writ petition no more survives as the accused has already been arrested and as such she is not inclined to press the writ petition.
4. In view of above, the writ petition is dismissed as not pressed.

(Prashant Kumar,J.) (Mahesh Chandra Tripathi,J.) Order Date :- 9.4.2025 SP/
